title: Storm Selvig — a portfolio you can play
question: Choose the direction you want to develop. These are visual concepts; the 3D objects are illustrative.

options.label: Kinetic Circuit
options.lineage: Modular electronics, mechanical music scores, tactile control panels
options.thesis: A playable instrument connects your hardware, robotics, and AI projects.
options.viewport: One giant 3D control surface: turn a dial, route a signal, then open the project behind the response.
options.risk: The instrument needs a clear first action so the metaphor never obscures your work.

raised.raise: Every action leaves a visible trace in the system.
One control visibly transforms connected parts.
Each project keeps its own authored story.
The selected experiment owns the whole viewport.
The active plane stays still while being read.

options.label: Object Playground
options.lineage: Physics toys and interactive science exhibits
options.thesis: Pick up a project, turn it over, and discover a small working experiment.
options.viewport: A roomy physics playground with a Smart Clock, ROV, and AI camera, each opening its own mini experience.
options.risk: The 3D-object portfolio is familiar territory; the custom interactions must give it personality.

options.label: Signal Space
options.thesis: Follow an input through a 3D system and discover the engineering behind it.
options.viewport: Send a simulated signal from a joystick through a circuit to an ROV thruster.
options.risk: More technical and less immediately playful; guided interactions matter.
options.case: Strong connection to robotics and software, with more explanation needed for nontechnical visitors.

canonCard.label: A straightforward portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A polished project gallery with a focused 3D viewer.
canonCard.viewport: Project index, featured work, and contact with an interactive model.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, but less experiential than your selected playground direction.
